spaces.limitation: Exterior boundaries and passages are committed; kitchen, bar, furniture, acoustic treatment and interior partitions remain deferred.

spaces.use: Generous bedroom suite with sleeping, dressing and bathroom capacity
spaces.limitation: Suite perimeter and entrance are selected, but bathroom, dressing and bedroom fit-out are not yet constructed.

spaces.name: Garden Ocean Suite 2
spaces.use: Generous bedroom suite with sleeping, dressing and bathroom capacity
spaces.limitation: Suite perimeter and entrance are selected, but bathroom, dressing and bedroom fit-out are deferred.

spaces.name: Upper Garden Suite 3
spaces.use: Private bedroom suite overlooking the landward tropical gardens
spaces.limitation: The bounded suite capacity is preserved; internal bathroom and wardrobe partitions remain unbuilt.

spaces.name: Upper Ocean Suite 4
spaces.use: Private bedroom suite with broad ocean-facing glazing
spaces.limitation: Bedroom, dressing and bathroom fit-out are deferred despite the distinct bounded allocation.

spaces.name: Upper Garden Suite 5
spaces.use: Private bedroom suite overlooking the arrival gardens

spaces.name: Primary Ocean Suite 6

spaces.name: Upper Bridge Gallery
spaces.use: Protected circulation connecting stair and all four upper suites
spaces.limitation: Guard geometry and detailed stair treads are reserved for the construction stage.

spaces.name: Ocean Entertainment Terrace
spaces.use: Outdoor dining, lounging and poolside entertainment
spaces.limitation: Outdoor furniture, kitchen equipment, drainage and guard requirements remain unresolved.

spaces.name: Ocean-Edge Pool
spaces.use: Long swimming and view-oriented water court
spaces.limitation: The basin, water and dry perimeter are represented; infinity overflow, catch basin, pumps, filtration and safety certification are unsupported.

spaces.name: Ceremonial Arrival Court
spaces.use: Vehicle drop-off and protected pedestrian approach
spaces.limitation: Vehicle turning performance, gates, lighting and permeable paving performance are not simulated.

spaces.name: West Tropical Privacy Garden
spaces.use: Layered planting reserve and private outlook for the western suites
spaces.limitation: Planting beds are spatially reserved, but species, irrigation and mature canopy are not simulated.

spaces.name: East Tropical Service Garden
spaces.use: Landscape screening and reserved service-side movement
spaces.limitation: Detailed service paving, waste handling, planting species and irrigation are deferred.

routesDetail.description: A level, dry ceremonial approach terminates at the sheltered 3.2 metre-wide entrance.
The central living volume opens through a true sill-zero garden door onto the terrace at the same 0.20 metre walking datum.
The terrace abuts the pool coping at its near edge, preserving a continuous dry route around the water.
A protected straight stair rises 4.00 metres to the bridge gallery beneath the elevated central roof.
The bridge turns into the western gallery and enters Suite 3 through its dedicated door.
The same protected gallery serves Suite 4 without crossing another suite.
The eastern gallery branch reaches Suite 5 through a distinct private threshold.
The primary suite is reached through a wider door at the quieter ocean end of the east gallery.
Suite 1 is entered from the western internal side gallery rather than directly from the public terrace.
Suite 2 is entered from the eastern internal side gallery, maintaining privacy from pool circulation.
